title: Lentsoe la ho Tiea
intro: Motho enoa o hopoloa ka bohlale le tataiso e tebileng, a fana ka keletso e fetang meloko. Mantsoe a bona ke bopaki ba boinehelo le bohlokoa ba ho lemoha litlhohonolofatso le liteko tse tsoang ho Molimo. Senola boitsebiso ba moea ona o hlomphehang.
clues: Ke ne ke se moporofeta, empa bohlale ba ka bo ke ke ba shwa Mangolong a Halalelang.
Keletso ea ka ho ngoana oa ka e ne e hatisa teboho ho Allah le ho qoba shirk.
Ke rutile ka bohlokoa ba thapelo, ho laela botle, le ho thibela bobe.
Ke lemositse khahlanong le boikhohomoso le ho tsamaea ka boikhohomoso lefatšeng.
Lebitso la ka le filoe khaolo eohle ho Quran, e totobatsang lithuto tsa ka.
Keletso ea ka e ne e kenyelletsa mamello mathateng, hobane ka 'nete, seo se tsoa litabeng tse tiileng ka ho fetisisa.

trial.label: Thuto/Tataiso ea Bohlokoa
options: Ho tobana le lebotho le matla
Ho fana ka bohlale le likeletso tsa boitšoaro
Ho etella sechaba pele ho ea tlholong
trial.answer: Ho fana ka bohlale le likeletso tsa boitšoaro

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: Bohlale ba hae bo tlalehiloe ho Quran
O ile a etella batho ba hae pele ho ea naheng e ncha
O ile a fuoa leruo le leholo
outcome.answer: Bohlale ba hae bo tlalehiloe ho Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
